announcement.msg_id: ARA 4.10.0 — Gambar Kerja lemari siap produksi langsung dari SketchUp (template, notasi gaya AutoCAD, potongan B-B & denah, tampak per bidang, daftar potong, PDF/DXF/DWG), ARA Kuas untuk menandai pintu/laci/material di model, dan Bagikan Tur 360 tanpa akun. Plugin SketchUp kini memakai lisensi ARA. Mohon perbarui: unduh di github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway).
announcement.msg_en: ARA 4.10.0 — production-ready cabinet Shop Drawings straight from SketchUp (templates, AutoCAD-style annotation, B-B & plan sections, per-plane elevations, cutting list, PDF/DXF/DWG), ARA Brush to mark doors/drawers/materials in the model, and account-free 360 Tour sharing. SketchUp plugins now use your ARA licence. Please update: download at github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway).
